p01-sofia-coat-on.observed_description: Sofia stands at her open front door, the street outside white with snow, pulling a long red coat up onto her shoulder, one arm in the sleeve; a white scarf hangs on a hook.
p01-sofia-coat-on.note: Usable: half-on coat and snow outside read at 250 px; she faces the snow, so putting on fits.

p02-diego-jacket-off.observed_description: Diego in a park wears a brown fleece jacket that he holds closed across his body.
p02-diego-jacket-off.note: Rejected: it reads as putting the jacket on or keeping warm, and nothing shows heat. Remade in v751.

p03-ana-gloves-on.observed_description: Ana in a navy winter coat and white knitted hat stands on a snowy street pulling a red woolen glove onto her hand; the other red glove is on.
p03-ana-gloves-on.note: Usable: the glove going on and the cold read at 180 px.

p04-luis-boots-off.observed_description: Luis stands on a doormat in an open doorway in a wet black raincoat holding one black boot while wearing two more.
p04-luis-boots-off.note: Rejected: three boots are visible and the rain outside is faint. Remade in v751.
